[Biased inventory]{.lit-num .bad}

[Steger, S., Brenning, A., Bell, R., Petschko, H., & Glade, T. (2016). Exploring discrepancies between quantitative validation results and the geomorphic plausibility of statistical landslide susceptibility maps. *Geomorphology*, 262, 8–23.]{.lit-cite}
